_notes: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for everything that must be identical across the four experiments.
Only the sampling strategy (--sampling) and LoRA config (--lora) may differ between runs; they are command-line flags of run_experiment.py, NOT set here.
Training hyper-parameters below are the defaults from train_qwen_lora.py. The team has not yet confirmed a final training budget: review before the real runs.
Paths are relative to the repo root. Data folders are gitignored (restricted SAP data).
Override a value for one launch with: --set training.learning_rate=5e-5 (applies to every experiment in that launch; the effective config is saved as config_used.json in each run folder).
